summary: Backend-only testing for MacroLens (gym/calorie tracker). Seeded session directly in MongoDB and tested all 15+ endpoints via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 15 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Covered auth (Bearer validation, invalid session_id), goals GET/PUT with persistence, foods CRUD, water get/increment (including negative clamp), weight create/list, workouts CRUD, /summary/today totals verification, barcode lookup (Nutella 3017620422003 = 200, invalid = 404), and Gemini 3 Flash AI food image analysis with a real JPEG (pizza image from Unsplash). Verified no MongoDB _id leaks in any JSON response via recursive assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 497-line file; still under the 700-line limit but as features grow (barcode, AI, workouts) consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth.py, foods.py, ai.py, barcode.py).
POST /api/water/increment takes 'delta' as a query param (not JSON body); this is functional but slightly non-idiomatic — a Pydantic body model would be more robust. Not blocking.
AI response parser assumes model returns valid JSON; falls back to 502 with response snippet — acceptable. Gemini 3 Flash returned parseable JSON reliably in tests.
get_current_user correctly excludes _id via projection; all endpoints use {'_id': 0} projections — good practice consistently applied.
auth_session inserts a new user_sessions row every login without deduping; over time this may accumulate. Non-critical due to TTL index on expires_at.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture seeds a TEST_ user, goals doc, and user_sessions token directly into Mongo (macrolens_db). Teardown cleans up all TEST_ data across users/goals/user_sessions/food_logs/water_logs/weight_entries/workouts collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://workout-tracker-1599.preview.emergentagent.com. To auth, either use POST /api/auth/session with a real Emergent session_id (unavailable in automation) OR seed user_sessions directly in Mongo (see conftest.py seeded_session fixture). All endpoints require Bearer token. Barcode uses OpenFoodFacts (no key). AI uses Emergent LLM key with gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview. Frontend not tested per request (Google OAuth blocks automation).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. All endpoints behaved per spec: 401 on missing/invalid bearer, 401 on invalid session_id, no _id leakage, correct persistence on all writes, water clamps to 0, summary totals aggregate foods*servings correctly, Gemini returns valid nutrition JSON, Nutella barcode returns real product data.
